note.value: Assumed positions and travel times; the dataset has no locations; proximity is never inferred from codes; city codes limit candidates to one city because the dataset card defines city_id as an encoded city ID
note.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user); 05.2-CONTEXT D-30: an assumed location and route mapping, clearly labelled Assumption with its source
note.note: a configurable scenario assumption, never a public-dataset fact

rule.value: each mapped store gets a point uniform in a disc of positions.city_radius_km around its city, drawn from a stream keyed by positions.seed, the city code and the store code; only distances inside one city are used
rule.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user): positions uniform in a 15 km disc per city; data/runs.py positions
rule.note: assumed positions, never observed; a city's centre is irrelevant

city_radius_km.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user): positions uniform in a 15 km disc per city

seed.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user): the 05.2-05 measurement seed, kept so the D-34 measured figures reproduce
seed.note: every draw is a keyed stream (data.runs._rng); a different seed is a different assumed map

unmapped.note: a store listed here is excluded from transfers and shows Transfers unavailable: location or route data missing; it keeps sales, forecast, stock, keep and markdown, and is counted in the data report (D-31)

source.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user); 05.2-CONTEXT D-29, D-30: the travel-time source is a setting; distance and travel time inside a city come only from the assumed mapping
source.note: assumed_positions: euclidean km between the assumed positions ÷ travel.speed_kmh × 60 + travel.handling_min, rounded up (data/runs.py travel_min); the only source data/runs.py implements

handling_min.note: loading and unloading, added to every trip

same_city.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user); 05.2-CONTEXT D-30: the dataset card defines city_id as an encoded city ID, so it may limit candidates to the same city; spec §5: transfers stay within a city
same_city.note: the city code is compared for equality only, never read as a distance

max_travel_min.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user): a 60 min service limit; 05.2-CONTEXT D-29: the maximum travel time is a setting, never a code constant
max_travel_min.note: a destination at exactly this travel time is eligible

filters.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user); 05.2-CONTEXT D-29 stage 1: the lot-independent eligibility; arrival before expiry, cold chain and receiving capacity are checked per lot at case time
filters.note: transport cost is never a filter: the engine weighs the run's cost against keep and markdown (D-29)

k.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user): k = 4, full search; a simulated truck schedule
k.note: each source keeps its k nearest eligible destinations by travel time, one run each per run day; a fallback to a lower k is set here with a rebuild only if 05.2-17 or 05.2-24 misses 3 s, and it discloses the reduced search coverage and keeps every at-risk lot

days.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user): runs every day 0..6; a simulated truck schedule

loading_cutoff_min.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user): cutoff 12:00; a simulated truck schedule

departs_min.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user): departure 12:30; a simulated truck schedule

spare_totes.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user): 15 spare totes; a simulated truck schedule

cold_chain_share.source: 05.2-06 D-34 (user): cold-chain share 0.667 (4 of the 6 synthetic runs); a simulated truck schedule

fixed_base.note: the quote is fixed_base + per_km × km; the engine compares it with keep and markdown, never a filter (D-29)

chilled.unit: free totes per store per day

ambient.unit: free totes per store per day
